The '''Corellian bloc''' was a coalition of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] colonies in the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]]. One of the colonies was the [[Baylin Cluster/Legends|Baylin Cluster]].

They were founded some time before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] and came into conflict with [[Barralenal]], a group of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] pilgrims who had settled in the same [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Matri Bey]] was unable to prevent both factions from engaging in [[Corellian/Aqualish war|war]].
